questions.stem: A bicycle racing track is a level circular road of radius 10 m; three cyclists P, Q and R on identical cycles at 2 m/s, 3 m/s and 5 m/s, coefficient of friction 0.1 — which cyclist will slip? (Take g = 10 m/s^2)
The bob of a simple pendulum is displaced from its mean position and released from rest 0.20 m above its mean position — speed of the bob as it passes through the mean position? (Take g = 10 m/s^2)
A tennis ball of mass 350 g is thrown vertically upwards at a speed of 4 m/s; M is the maximum gravitational potential energy and H the maximum height — which one is correct? (Take g = 10 m/s^2)
Which of the following is correct regarding the total internal reflection at the interface between two different optical media?

options.label: A
options.text: The phenomenon of total internal reflection can occur only if light is passing at any angle from a medium of low refractive index to a medium of high refractive index.

options.label: B
options.text: The phenomenon of total internal reflection can occur only if light is passing from a medium of high refractive index to a medium of low refractive index and at an angle greater than the critical angle.

options.label: C
options.text: The phenomenon of total internal reflection can occur only if light is passing at any angle from a medium of high refractive index to a medium of low refractive index.

options.label: D
options.text: The phenomenon of total internal reflection can occur only if light is passing from a medium of low refractive index to a medium of high refractive index and at an angle greater than the critical angle.
